title: Review: atomic outbound msg + fail-early host lookup
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — _caller_identity enforcement gap is a latent auth bypass on next peer handler; orphaned-pending message is a low-frequency UX cliff. Core change (atomic transaction + fail-early host lookup) is sound.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) _caller_identity extraction in existing Peer/deliver and Peer/receipt handlers not re-audited in this review — if either has a latent omission it wouldn't be visible in this diff; (2) empty-outbox behavior for group chats not covered by any test. Would raise confidence if: a test covers Message/set create to a group chat with zero members (verify delivery_state or error), and a grep confirms both existing Peer/* handlers do extract _caller_identity as their first operation.
